code_summary: Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional embeddings, maximum sequence length 128, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 1, 2, 4, 8]. Each block contains two left-padded width-3 convolutions, layer normalization, GELU, and dropout 0.2. Normalized item inputs are scaled and combined with learned positions; padding is masked. Final sequence representations are normalized and scored by dot products with raw item embeddings. Constructor, forward, encode_sequence, and score_candidates interfaces are preserved.
